comment: session.create result (jsonrpc-methods-and-events.md 1.1). Returns BOTH id spaces: the ephemeral 8-hex runtime `session_id` that every RPC and event carries, and the durable `stored_session_id` (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_xxxxxx) that session.resume / session.delete and the REST routes take. info.desktop_contract is the only explicit protocol version in this layer (6.1); current backend value is 5.
